Decoded by Galvor, Issue #17: Same Budget, $3,800 Moved. Inside a Linen Brand's First Month

A premium linen and cotton D2C brand didn't spend more in its first month with Galvor. It spent differently: $3,800 moved between ads, and RoAS rose 67%. This issue walks through the calls behind that move, why hold rate rose with it, and which parts any brand can copy.

Subscribe to get it every Wednesday.
